question: Welche Regierungsebene bildet den unteren Teil des gestapelten Balkendiagramms im linken Panel?
question_english: Which level of government forms the bottom part of the stacked bar chart in the left panel?
model_answer: The lower portion of the stacked bar chart in the left panel is formed by the "Gemeinden" (municipalities) data. Both Länder (regions) and Gemeinden data show a roughly similar trend over time.  The total "Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt" (territorial units in total) line indicates a decreasing trend over the period.
